$comment: Design-system enforcement for OpenGeo. The tool auto-loads DESIGN.md from the
repo root, so the rules in that document are the source of truth and this file
only records the two mechanical exceptions. Do not add an entry here to silence a
finding you disagree with - fix DESIGN.md or the code, because a suppression is a
lie about the state of the product.

broken-image.reason: The two remaining hits were deliberately malformed HTML fixtures inside test files: page-analyzer.test.ts and site-audit-workflow-helpers.test.ts assert that the crawler DETECTS a missing src and an empty alt. They are the analyser's own test data, not shipped UI. Both are covered by ignoreFiles above; this entry is belt-and-braces in case a fixture moves.
